title: Acme GX-2000 Service Manual, Rev A
heading: Oil change
text: FICTIONAL TEST TEXT. Change the engine oil on the GX-2000 every 50 hours of operation. Drain the oil through the drain plug while the engine is warm, then refill with 0.6 litres.

title: Acme GX-2000 Service Manual, Rev B
heading: Oil change
text: FICTIONAL TEST TEXT. Change the engine oil on the GX-2000 every 100 hours of operation. Drain the oil through the drain plug while the engine is warm, replace the oil filter, then refill with 0.7 litres.

title: Acme GX-2000 Service Manual, Rev B
heading: Engine will not start
text: FICTIONAL TEST TEXT. If the GX-2000 engine will not start, check that the fuel valve is open, the choke is set, and the low-oil shutdown switch is not tripped.

title: Acme GX-3000 Service Manual
heading: Oil change
text: FICTIONAL TEST TEXT. Change the engine oil on the GX-3000 every 200 hours of operation and replace the oil filter at every second oil change.

title: Portable Generator Safety
heading: Carbon monoxide
text: FICTIONAL TEST TEXT. Never run a portable generator indoors, in a garage, or near open windows. Generator exhaust contains carbon monoxide, which can kill within minutes.

title: Portable Generator Safety
heading: Maintenance
text: FICTIONAL TEST TEXT. Follow the manufacturer's schedule to change the engine oil on any generator. Let the engine cool before refueling.

title: Outdoor Burning Rules, Texas
heading: Burn bans
text: FICTIONAL TEST TEXT. Outdoor burning of brush is prohibited in any county under a burn ban. Check the county burn ban status before outdoor burning.

title: Outdoor Burning Rules, California
heading: Burn permits
text: FICTIONAL TEST TEXT. Outdoor burning of brush requires a permit from the local air district. Burning is allowed only on permissive burn days.

title: Community Q&A
heading: Generator noise
text: FICTIONAL TEST TEXT. To reduce generator noise, place the generator on a rubber mat and point the exhaust away from the house.
